intentos_detalle.sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) / 
        (SELECT SUM(payment_value) FROM order_payments op 
         JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id 
         WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), 2) AS pct_distintos_metodos_pago
FROM order_payments op
JOIN order_items oi ON op.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE op.payment_sequential != (SELECT MAX(payment_sequential) 
                                FROM order_payments op2 
                                JOIN order_items oi2 ON op2.order_id = oi2.order_id 
                                WHERE op2.order_id = oi.order_id)
